title: Mobilityaid Status Rolling 7-Day Value Average
dataSources: Mobility-aid status (`mobilityaid:status`), wheelchair battery telemetry (`wheelchair:battery`), stairlift service records (`stairlift:service`), hearing-aid battery records (`hearingaid:battery`), pendant-alert tests (`pendant:test`).
app: Wheelchair battery telemetry, stairlift service records, hearing-aid battery reminders, and pendant-alert test logs streamed to Splunk HEC via apps, service portals, and caregiver forms.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=mobilityaid:status value=*
| bin _time span=1d
| stats avg(value) as daily_avg by _time
| streamstats window=7 avg(daily_avg) as rolling_7d
| sort _time
description: Tracks a seven-day rolling average of daily value for mobilityaid status data.
value: Rolling averages highlight gradual drift without overreacting to one-off days.
implementation: Compute daily average `value` then a seven-day rolling mean for mobilityaid status events.
visualization: Line chart of daily and rolling average value.
grandmaExplanation: It treats the smoothed week-long trend in your value from mobilityaid status.
